clips.title: The story
paras: Harken Windtotem is a tauren huntsman residing in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. Dedicated to the traditions of his people, he tasks young hunters and travelers with proving their tracking and foraging skills across the golden plains.

Situated near the heart of Bloodhoof Village, Harken Windtotem serves as an instructor and guide for those learning the hunting ways of the tauren. Life on the plains of Mulgore demands respect for the natural world alongside the practical skill to sustain one's tribe. Harken evaluates young adventurers by directing them to hunt the native swoops that circle the mesas, collecting their quills to gauge a hunter's patience, aim, and ability to harvest without waste.
